where.en: Garbage truck, in an official bag

where.en: Book a pickup with the cleaning squad

label.en: Bottles, cans, plastics, styrofoam, small electronics

note.en: Free pickup for households. Book at least 1 day ahead with your district cleaning squad, or through 1999. Pickup runs Mon–Sat.
note.zh: 家戶免費收運。至少前一天向各區清潔隊預約，或透過 1999 預約，週一至週六收運。

text.en: Pour the drink and pearls out. Pearls and ice go to food waste or the sink.
text.zh: 倒掉飲料。珍珠等料可當廚餘。

text.en: Remove the sealing film and straw — they are general trash. The cup and lid go to recycling.
text.zh: 撕下封膜、拿出吸管丟一般垃圾；杯子、杯蓋回收。

text.zh: 杯子疊好節省空間。

text.en: Leftover food goes to food waste.
text.zh: 剩菜當廚餘。

text.en: Pour out what is left and give it a quick rinse.
text.zh: 倒掉剩餘內容物，簡單沖一下。

text.en: Wet recyclables can make other items dirty.
text.zh: 濕的回收物會弄髒其他回收物。

warn.en: Wooden lunch boxes are NOT recyclable — general trash.
warn.zh: 木片餐盒不可回收，當一般垃圾。

handover.en: Hand it to the crew on the recycling truck that follows the garbage truck (Tue / Thu / Sat). Free — no special bag needed.

text.en: Only clean styrofoam is recycled. Wipe or rinse food containers.
text.zh: 只收乾淨的保麗龍，餐具要先擦乾淨。

warn.en: Sponge / foam filling (泡棉) is not recyclable.

handover.en: Hand it to the crew on the recycling truck that follows the garbage truck (Tue / Thu / Sat). Free — no special bag needed.

text.en: Factory-reset phones and computers first.
text.zh: 手機、電腦先回復原廠設定。

text.en: Batteries are recycled separately.
text.zh: 電池要另外回收。

handover.en: Hand it to the crew on the recycling truck that follows the garbage truck (Tue / Thu / Sat). Free — no special bag needed.
handover.zh: 交給跟著垃圾車的資源回收車人員（二、四、六）。免費，不需專用垃圾袋。

text.en: Remove tape and flatten.
text.zh: 撕掉膠帶，攤平。

text.en: Tie paper into a bundle so it does not fly away.
text.zh: 綁好避免飛散。

warn.en: Greasy paper, tissues, glossy laminated paper and photo paper are general trash.
warn.zh: 沾油的紙、衛生紙、上膜光面紙、照片紙都是一般垃圾。

handover.en: Hand it to the crew on the recycling truck that follows the garbage truck (Mon / Fri). Free — no special bag needed.
handover.zh: 交給跟著垃圾車的資源回收車人員（一、五）。免費，不需專用垃圾袋。

text.en: Only clean, dry clothes are accepted.
text.zh: 只收乾淨、乾燥的衣物。

text.en: Put them in any bag.
text.zh: 用任何袋子裝好。

warn.en: Towels, socks, underpants, bedding, curtains and torn or smelly clothes are general trash.
warn.zh: 毛巾、襪子、內褲、棉被、窗簾，以及破舊發臭的衣物都是一般垃圾。

handover.en: Hand it to the crew on the recycling truck that follows the garbage truck (Mon / Fri). Free — no special bag needed.
handover.zh: 交給跟著垃圾車的資源回收車人員（一、五）。免費，不需專用垃圾袋。

text.en: No oil, soup or blood.
text.zh: 不能有油漬、湯汁、血水。

warn.en: Snack and chip bags (shiny, mixed material) are general trash.
warn.zh: 零食、餅乾包裝袋（複合材質）是一般垃圾。

handover.en: Hand it to the crew on the recycling truck that follows the garbage truck (Mon / Fri). Free — no special bag needed.
handover.zh: 交給跟著垃圾車的資源回收車人員（一、五）。免費，不需專用垃圾袋。

handover.en: Hand it to the crew on the recycling truck that follows the garbage truck (Mon / Fri). Free — no special bag needed.
handover.zh: 交給跟著垃圾車的資源回收車人員（一、五）。免費，不需專用垃圾袋。

text.en: Less water means less smell.
text.zh: 瀝乾比較不臭。

text.en: Keep it in a sealed box in the fridge until truck day.
text.zh: 用密封盒放冰箱，等收運日再拿出。

handover.en: Since 2026 all food waste is one category. Pour it into the food-waste bucket at the back of the garbage truck. The empty plastic bag goes in your general trash.
handover.zh: 2026 年起廚餘不分生熟，一律倒進垃圾車後方的廚餘桶。倒完的塑膠袋當一般垃圾。

handover.en: Since 2026 all food waste is one category. Pour it into the food-waste bucket at the back of the garbage truck. The empty plastic bag goes in your general trash.
handover.zh: 2026 年起廚餘不分生熟，一律倒進垃圾車後方的廚餘桶。倒完的塑膠袋當一般垃圾。

text.en: The bag or filter paper is general trash.
text.zh: 茶包袋、濾紙是一般垃圾。

handover.en: Since 2026 all food waste is one category. Pour it into the food-waste bucket at the back of the garbage truck. The empty plastic bag goes in your general trash.

text.en: These shells are too hard for food waste. Collect them separately.
text.zh: 殼太硬，不能混在廚餘裡，請另外收集。

handover.en: Hand them to the recycling truck crew, separate from food waste.
handover.zh: 另外收集後交給資源回收車。

text.en: Cover the metal ends with tape to prevent fire.
text.zh: 用膠帶貼住兩端，避免短路起火。

warn.en: Never put batteries in the garbage bag — they can start fires in the truck.
warn.zh: 電池絕對不能丟垃圾袋，可能讓垃圾車起火。

handover.en: Pack it separately and hand it to the recycling crew. Never put it in the garbage bag.
handover.zh: 分開包好交給回收車人員，絕對不要放進垃圾袋。

text.en: Do not break it — tubes contain mercury.
text.zh: 不要打破，燈管含汞。

text.en: Put it back in its box or wrap with paper.
text.zh: 放回原包裝或用紙包好。

handover.en: Pack it separately and hand it to the recycling crew. Never put it in the garbage bag.
handover.zh: 分開包好交給回收車人員，絕對不要放進垃圾袋。

title.en: Pour into a bottle and cap it

text.en: Let it cool first.
text.zh: 先放涼。

warn.en: Do not pour oil down the sink.

handover.en: Pack it separately and hand it to the recycling crew. Never put it in the garbage bag.
handover.zh: 分開包好交給回收車人員，絕對不要放進垃圾袋。

handover.zh: 分開包好交給回收車人員，絕對不要放進垃圾袋。

handover.en: Put it in a Taipei official garbage bag, tie it, and throw it into the garbage truck yourself.
handover.zh: 裝進臺北市專用垃圾袋、綁好，自己丟進垃圾車。

text.en: Book at least 1 day ahead. Tell them your address and the item; they set a time and place.
text.zh: 至少前一天預約，說明地址與物品，清潔隊會約定時間地點。

title.en: Put it out on the agreed day
title.zh: 在約定日放到指定地點

warn.en: Do not leave furniture on the street without booking.
warn.zh: 未預約不可擅自丟在路邊。

text.en: Tell them your address and the item. They give you a pickup date.
text.zh: 說明地址與物品，清潔隊會約時間。

text.en: General trash must go in a Taipei City official garbage bag. Buy them at convenience stores and supermarkets. Sizes 3 L–120 L, e.g. 14 L: NT$100 for 20 bags, or NT$5 for one retail bag.
text.zh: 一般垃圾必須裝在臺北市專用垃圾袋。便利商店、超市都買得到。容量 3–120 公升，例如 14 公升一包 20 個 100 元，零售單個 5 元。

tip.en: Recycling, food waste and bulky-waste pickup are free — no special bag needed.
tip.zh: 資源回收、廚餘與大型廢棄物預約收運都免費，不需專用袋。

warn.en: Not using an official bag can be fined from NT$1,200 (Waste Disposal Act).
warn.zh: 未使用專用垃圾袋，依廢棄物清理法可處 1,200 元起罰鍰。

text.en: 1. General trash (official bag)  2. Recycling (any bag)  3. Food waste (a box or bag).
text.zh: 1. 一般垃圾（專用袋）2. 資源回收（任何袋子）3. 廚餘（盒子或袋子）。

tip.en: Not sure? Use "What is this item?" on the home page.
tip.zh: 不確定？用首頁的「這是什麼垃圾？」查詢。

text.en: No collection on Wednesday and Sunday. Paper & clothes: Mon / Fri. Bottles, cans & plastics: Tue / Thu / Sat.
text.zh: 每週三、日停收。紙類、舊衣：一、五。瓶罐、塑膠：二、四、六。

tip.en: Lunar New Year has a special schedule announced by the Department of Environmental Protection.
tip.zh: 農曆春節收運時間依環保局公告調整。

text.en: The truck stops at fixed places at fixed times, usually only a few minutes. Arrive 5 minutes early.
text.zh: 垃圾車在固定地點、固定時間停靠，通常只停幾分鐘，請提早 5 分鐘到。

tip.en: Missed it? The city runs limited-time drop-off points in every district.
tip.zh: 錯過了？各區有環保局的限時收受點。

text.en: Trucks play music as they come (often "Für Elise"). A recycling truck runs on the same route.
text.zh: 垃圾車來時會播放音樂（常見為〈給愛麗絲〉），同路線也有資源回收車。

text.en: Throw the official bag into the garbage truck. Give recyclables to the recycling crew. Pour food waste into the bucket at the back of the truck.
text.zh: 專用袋丟進垃圾車；回收物交給回收車人員；廚餘倒進車後方的廚餘桶。

warn.en: Never leave trash on the street or by a pole — Taipei has no curbside bins. You can be fined.
warn.zh: 不可把垃圾放在路邊或電線桿旁（垃圾不落地），會被開罰。
